name: Surveyor 3

hotspots.label: Look at Earth in the sky

parts.name: Solar panel
parts.role: Makes power, but only in sunlight

parts.name: Planar antenna
parts.role: A flat antenna that sends data home
parts.snap: Antenna on. Without it, no pictures reach Earth.

parts.name: Frame and mast
parts.snap: Frame locked. Everything hangs off this.

parts.name: Legs with footpads
parts.snap: Legs on. They had a rough day.

parts.name: Sampler arm
parts.role: A scoop on an arm that digs trenches

challenge.title: Soft landing
challenge.intro: Hold the button to fire the engine. Touch down slower than 3 m/s. Gravity never stops pulling.
challenge.hint: Do not fire too early, or the fuel runs out before the ground.

signal_note: Last contact, loss of power and the official end are three different events. For Surveyor 3 we could verify two of them.
ending: Surveyor 3 is still on the Moon, and people once walked up to it.
